name: CADELL, Ross Philip

headline.note: Career evidence identifies events, motorsport, professional sport, party and port roles, but substantive full-time status and complete calendar boundaries are not established for the potentially countable roles. Port of Newcastle had mixed ownership, including a 50% China Merchants Port interest, so it is not silently classified as wholly private. Party work and elected office are excluded; missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.employer: Newcastle National Maritime Festival (legal employing entity unresolved)
career_spells.evidence_note: Contemporaneous Newcastle Herald reports, summarized in the secondary career source, identify Cadell as festival event manager in 2002–2004. The legal employer, exact dates, pay, hours and organisational control are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Neither employer sector nor substantive full-time status is sufficiently supported.

career_spells.employer: Alex Yoong / motorsport sponsorship arrangement (legal entity unresolved)
career_spells.evidence_note: A May 2004 motorsport release names Cadell as Alex Yoong's Australian manager, and his official personal biography confirms Formula 1/V8 Supercars experience. The contracting entity, end date, remuneration, weekly hours and overlap with other roles are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Private commercial activity is supported, but no countable full-time interval is established.

career_spells.evidence_note: A contemporaneous Newcastle Herald report, summarized by the secondary career source, places his commencement in June 2005. His current official biography confirms work at the Knights. End date, employing legal entity, ownership form, hours and leave are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: The club role is preserved, but employer classification and full-time duration are not sufficiently supported.

career_spells.evidence_note: A February 2007 Newcastle Herald report, summarized in the secondary career source, identifies Cadell as commercial director of the Newcastle motorsport team. The exact start/end dates, legal entity, hours, remuneration and overlap with other motorsport work are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: A private-enterprise role is identified, but no substantive full-time interval is proven.

career_spells.evidence_note: His current official biography says he dedicated nearly ten years to the NSW Nationals before the Senate. Reliable reporting places organiser/campaign-manager work from 2010 and records his promotion to state director in 2018. Individual campaign assignments, exact dates, hours and leave are incomplete.
career_spells.counting_note: Party-organisation employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The Land reported his appointment in January 2018; January 2020 reporting describes him as the outgoing state director on appointment to the port. Exact employment dates, hours and leave are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party-organisation employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Port of Newcastle Operations Pty Ltd
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen biography supplies 2020–2022 and January 2020 reporting establishes appointment timing. His official biography describes oversight of the proposed multipurpose deepwater terminal and alternative-energy precincts. Port of Newcastle states that The Infrastructure Fund and China Merchants Port Holdings each own 50%; the latter belongs to a state-controlled Chinese group. Exact cessation date, hours, leave and the 2021–2022 Senate campaign overlap are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: The employer was not wholly government-controlled or wholly private-controlled on the evidence used. Mixed control and unproven full-time status prevent assignment to either headline sector.

career_spells.evidence_note: June 2021 reporting establishes preselection as the Nationals' lead Senate candidate. Pay, hours, formal employment status, campaign leave and overlap with Port of Newcastle are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party/campaign activity is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster and current official biographies establish Senate service from 1 July 2022. Parliamentary and shadow roles are nested within elected service.
career_spells.counting_note: Elected office is excluded under the codebook.
